append_metrics.name: CDU manufacturing lead time
append_metrics.description: Custom CDU design, manufacturing, and integration: 8–12 months from order (majority 10–12 months for specialized AI datacenter designs). Constraint driven by design complexity and thermal tuning per facility.

append_metrics.name: Global CDU installed capacity (2025 estimate)
append_metrics.description: Estimated global datacenter CDU deployment ~450 GW cumulative thermal capacity across all datacenters; AI/HPC segment growing 40–50% YoY 2023–2026, creating sustained procurement pressure.

append_metrics.name: Top-3 CDU supplier concentration
append_metrics.description: Vertiv (~35–40%), CoolIT Systems (~15–20%), and Schneider Electric / regional integrators (~15–20%) account for ~65–75% of AI datacenter CDU market share by revenue 2025–2026.

node_patches.append_notes: CDU is a supply-constrained module in 2024–2025 datacenter liquid-cooling buildout. Lead time (8–12 months) is often the pacing item for new datacenter thermal deployments. Constraint is driven by: (1) custom design and integration per facility (no commodity CDU), (2) limited supplier base (top 3 control ~65% market), (3) manufacturing capacity fully allocated to major cloud operators. The bottleneck gates accelerator module deployment schedules when datacenters scale from air cooling to sealed/open liquid loops.

Scope boundary note: rack_power_supply_unit represents the transition to facility-level infrastructure. Beyond rack PSU (facility AC/DC conversion, large distribution transformers, grid switchgear) is OUT OF SCOPE; modeled in ai_dc_power_chain domain. This decomposition stops at 12V/48V intermediate distribution into the accelerator module.
